C1281.title: Shanghai Police Crack Down on AI-Powered Article Spinning Harming Business Interests
C1281.summary: In 2025, professional social media operator Yao hired Lu to use AI tools to generate false articles about a tea beverage company and posted them across more than ten self-media accounts, causing a revenue drop of over 20% at some of the company's outlets.
